case.title: Participant straight-lines each form with a different value; the all-1s one still fires

submissions.open_text: Lake water looks cloudy after heavy rain
Borehole committee charges a monthly fee per family
Vendors refuse to deliver when roads flood

case.why: A fabricator varies the repeated value from form to form, so no two forms share an answer pattern. The check is per submission: all 8 answers equal fires regardless of the value and regardless of other forms. Several wrong implementations would stay silent here. One looks for a repeated pattern across the contributor's submissions. One only flags the top value 5. One treats the all-1s grid specially, for example as low or empty. Another wrongly exempts participants. Quiet checks: as a participant, 280 s is at least 180 s. same_spot never applies to participants. The texts share no content words. There are no voice notes. All times are daytime. One contributor uses the device. There are 3 submissions, below the participant burst threshold of 5. All points are inside Nyalenda.
